extracted.intended_audience: researchers preparing NIH-style grant applications (senior/key personnel completing biosketches and facilities & other resources)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and required content for the 'Facilities & Other Resources' and the NIH-format Biographical Sketch (Senior/Key Person Profile Expanded) used in grant applications; includes required fields, section headings, length limits, and examples of content to include.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources — overall content
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the laboratories and core facilities that support the proposed research, including equipment physically located in laboratories or available through shared institutional or departmental core facilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List major equipment and facilities available to perform the experiments described, explain how shared equipment or institutional cores will be used, and identify technical staff who provide training and support (e.g., 'The center is staffed by a technician who provides training and support'). Include enough detail to show capability to complete the proposed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major equipment available for this project (per participant)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a breakdown by participant of the major equipment to be used on the project (for example: microscopes, servers for data analysis, AFM, confocal microscopes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each listed instrument include model/brand when possible, functional capabilities (e.g., 'inverted confocal epifluorescent laser-scanning microscope (Fluoview, Olympus)'), how it will be used in the project (e.g., imaging GFP, YFP, PI), and note whether equipment is sharable between labs or provided by cores.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imaging equipment specifications and relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Detail specific instrumentation specs relevant to the proposed measurements (e.g., laser lines, photomultiplier tubes, camera models and quantum efficiency, frame rates, objectives, temperature/humidity-controlled enclosures).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give quantitative specs that demonstrate suitability (examples from text: 'Orca Flash 4.0 camera... over 70% quantum efficiency at 600 nm, low noise (1.3 electrons at 100 frames/sec), 4 megapixels... capable of 100 frames/sec at full resolution'; 'enclosures... stable to within 0.1 °C over days'). Mention automation or software control if relevant (e.g., 'software-controlled, allowing long-term, automated data acquisition').

rubrics_metrics.name: Describe access to cores and shared resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Name institutional centers/cores (e.g., 'TTU Materials Characterization Center') and list the range of equipment they provide (AFM, confocal, DSC, SEM, FTIR, microspore analyzer, x-ray diffractometer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain that cores are staffed and provide training/support; indicate any limits or terms of access if relevant. Showing core availability supports feasibility and resource sufficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Laboratory infrastructure for biological/microbiological work
rubrics_metrics.description: List microbiological storage, culture, and characterization equipment available in PI and collaborators' laboratories (e.g., -80 freezer, CO2 incubators, shaking incubators, spectrophotometers, PCR thermocyclers, autoclaves, laminar flow hoods).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate that space and routine microbiology equipment are available and sufficient for proposed experiments; include specialized items (e.g., cryostat for histopathology, wound imaging systems) when they are key to the plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH — format and length requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere strictly to the provided headings and the five-page limit. Include the required fields (name, eRA Commons user name, position title, education/training, etc.) in the specified order.

rubrics_metrics.name: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH — required header/contact fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Include name, eRA COMMONS user name (credential), POSITION TITLE, and other contact/organizational fields required by the Profile form (organization, department, address, phone, e-mail).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the Project Role (e.g., PD/PI), Degree Type and Year, Other Project Role Category, and attach files for Biographical Sketch and Current & Pending Support as indicated on the form (e.g., 'Attach Biographical Sketch*: Vernita_Gordon_Biosketch...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training section requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education (include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable). Add/delete rows as necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each entry provide 'Institution and Location', 'Degree (if applicable)', 'Completion Date MM/YYYY', and 'Field of Study'. Follow the chronological structure shown in the form examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement content
rubrics_metrics.description: A concise statement describing the individual's suitability for the role on the project, their relevant expertise, and why they are well-positioned to oversee or contribute to the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Personal Statement to tie past expertise and accomplishments to the current proposal (examples in text: multidisciplinary approach, unique positioning, specific technical skills). Cite relevant collaborative experience and supporting evidence (e.g., publications, previous publications under review with collaborators).

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions, Honors, and Other Experience
rubrics_metrics.description: List positions and employment history, other relevant experience, professional memberships, and honors in a section labeled 'Positions and Honors' or 'Other Experience and Professional Memberships.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include dates and brief descriptors; include notable service roles (e.g., study section memberships, editorial boards), invited talks, and awards that demonstrate standing and suitability for the proposed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributions to Science format
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a 'Contributions to Science' section that outlines major thematic research contributions, with numbered items and example publications for each theme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the theme, why it matters, and list representative publications (with brief descriptors if desired). The page shows numbered thematic descriptions followed by specific citations and notes of significance (e.g., F1000 recommendations, feature stories).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publications list guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Include 'Publications most-closely related to the present proposal' and reference a 'Complete List of Published Work' (e.g., via MyBibliography link).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select and list those publications most relevant to the proposed work; provide a link to the comprehensive bibliography for reviewers who want the full record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support (Ongoing and Completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: List ongoing and completed research support, indicating role (PI/co-PI), funding source, title, and dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe how prior and current support relates to the proposed project; include completed awards that provided relevant capability (example: NSF MRI acquisition used to acquire a microscope). Distinguish ongoing vs completed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Senior/Key Person Profile fields and attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete the Research & Related Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded) with fields such as Prefix, First Name, Last Name, Position/Title, Organization Name, Department, Contact fields, Project Role, Degree Type, Degree Year, and attachments for Biographical Sketch and Current & Pending Support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide file names for attachments where required, include tracking numbers and Funding Opportunity Number references when present (e.g., 'Tracking Number: GRANT12284250', 'Funding Opportunity Number: PAR-16-242'). Ensure consistency between profile fields and attached documents.
